jobPostingInfo.title: DevOps Engineer
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Balt Bank Technology runs the payment platform for 3 million customers.

What you will do

  • Build and run Kubernetes clusters on AWS with Terraform
  • Own the CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions and Argo CD
  • Improve monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana

What you bring

  • 3+ years of experience in a DevOps or SRE role
  • Good Linux and Python or Bash scripting
  • English at B2 level
